You need an unblocked exit? You should try going east. There is an exit to the south. Don't worry, it is unguarded. You don't like doors? Why not try going west, that entranceway is unblocked.

summary: I looked around the cramped attic but did not find the coin.
thought: I should try to take the coin from the floor in the cramped attic to be sure.
feedback: You can't see any such thing.
